title: Audit effective POSIX mode permissions
prompt: Implement solve(payload) for user {"uid":integer,"groups":[integer,...]} and files containing {"path":string,"mode":string,"owner_uid":integer,"group_gid":integer,"directory":boolean}. Mode is exactly 3 or 4 octal digits (0..7), interpreted as POSIX permission/special bits. Choose owner bits if user.uid==owner_uid, otherwise group bits if group_gid is in user.groups, otherwise other bits; never combine classes or fall back to a more permissive class. UID 0 has no special override in this synthetic evaluator. Convert the chosen three bits into an "rwx" string with "-" for absent bits. Return {"entries":[{"path":original_path,"effective":string,"risks":[...]}]} in file order. Risks in fixed order: "world_writable" when other-write is set unless this is a directory with sticky bit set; "setuid" whenever bit 04000 is set; "setgid" whenever bit 02000 is set. No filesystem access. Validate every mode first; invalid mode returns {"error":"invalid_mode"}. Any numeric inputs are finite; inputs have the documented shapes; unspecified validation is out of scope. Do not mutate payload or any nested value. Numeric absolute tolerance 0, relative tolerance 0; strings, booleans, errors and collection shapes must match exactly.
